title: Waggle Dance Hive
summary: Modelled on honeybee foraging and house-hunting. Scouts fly out to explore options and come back to dance: the waggle run points to the option and its vigour shows the quality. Recruits follow the strongest dances and check for themselves, so good options gain followers fast. When enough bees agree (a quorum), the hive commits. The queen's scent keeps the hive one.
whenToUse: Choosing among many options under uncertainty (a route, a library, a strategy), especially when scouting is cheap and committing is costly.
strengths: Good options win by evidence, not by rank
Quorum gives a clear moment to commit
risks: An early strong dance can win before a better scout returns
Depends on honest vigour (no inflated dances)

smileMetrics.cooperation: Recruits who confirmed a scout's report.
smileMetrics.harmony: Share of the hive on the chosen option at commit.

communication: Scouts go out and back each round; dances are visible to the whole hive; recruits choose by vigour; the queen's heartbeat (the intention line) reaches all each round. Commit at quorum.
cooperation: Cooperation = confirmed dances ÷ dances. Harmony = share of the hive at commit.

roles.name: Hive Mind (queen)
Scout
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per region. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🐝🔭 ***Scout [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You explore [$Region$] of the options for [$Question$]. ) :)
(: Listen ( Your region only. ) :)
[= Dance with the vigour your evidence supports. Revisit your option once before dancing again. =]
[: Response Format (
🐝🔭 ***Scout [$n$]***:
# Dance
{option, vigour 1-5}
# Evidence
{what you saw}
) :]

roles.prompt:
(; Write one per recruit. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🐝🧭 ***Recruit [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You follow a dance and check the option yourself. ) :)
(: Listen ( Every dance on the floor. ) :)
[= Follow dances in proportion to their vigour. Dance only what you confirmed. =]
[: Response Format (
🐝🧭 ***Recruit [$n$]***:
# Followed
{which dance}
# Confirm
{vigour after your own check}
) :]
